name: Dobbm
description: Dobbm is a traditional trick-taking game unique to the Stubai Valley in Tyrol, Austria. It is an 'Ace-Ten' game related to Tarock and Tapp, played with a 36-card Tell-pattern deck. The name refers to the 4-card talon known as the 'Dobb'.

content.text: Dobbm is a traditional trick-taking game unique to the Stubai Valley in Tyrol, Austria. It is an 'Ace-Ten' game related to Tarock and Tapp, played with a 36-card Tell-pattern deck. The name refers to the 4-card talon known as the 'Dobb'.
Dobbm is a hyper-local tradition centered in the village of Fulpmes. It was documented in 1996 by John McLeod and Remigius Geiser.
4 active players. If 5 play, the dealer 'feiert' (takes a holiday) and sits out.
36 German-suited (Tell) cards. Suits: Hearts, Leaves, Acorns, Bells.
8 cards to each player dealt in batches of 4. Four cards go face-down to the center as the 'Dobb'. The dealer for a hand is always the 'declarer' from the previous hand.
